instruction: Candid photographic still, medium close-up. In a bright ballet studio with wooden barres, the girl with light brown hair in a bun (R1) is in the right foreground wearing a pink leotard, looking off-camera left. Behind her, the girl in the pink ballet skirt (R2) stands with hands on hips, looking down-left. A cropped hand of an instructor is visible on the far left. Soft, even indoor lighting creates a clean, pastel color palette.
